title.rendered: How to install macOS Golden Gate 27 developer beta 4 on your Mac

content.rendered:
Apple has now released macOS Golden Gate developer beta 4, and it’s the most polished build yet. First unveiled at WWDC 2026, macOS Golden Gate brings a refined Liquid Glass design with better readability, deeper Apple Intelligence integration across Photos, Safari, Passwords, and Image Playground, and a significantly smarter Siri AI that lives right in Spotlight.

Beta 4 sharpens things further with improved Liquid Glass opacity and shadowing so it’s easier to tell when a window is active, uniform toolbars, edge-to-edge sidebars, fewer icons cluttering the menu bar, Visual Intelligence now built into the Mac, and an option to let AI automatically update your weak passwords.

Worth noting: macOS Golden Gate is the first macOS release built exclusively for Apple silicon. If your Mac runs an Intel processor, this will be the last upgrade you can make. Intel apps will still run via Rosetta 2 for now, but the transition is complete.

If you want to be among the first to experience what’s changed, here’s how to download and install macOS Golden Gate developer beta 4 on your Mac.

Things to know before installing macOS Golden Gate 27 developer beta 4

Before you download the beta, keep the following points in mind:

  • Developer betas are early versions of software and may contain bugs, performance issues, and app compatibility problems.
  • Some third-party apps may not work properly until they’re updated for macOS 27.
  • Installing beta software on your primary work Mac isn’t recommended.
  • Create a complete backup of your Mac before proceeding so you can restore your data if needed.

Macs compatible with macOS Golden Gate 27

Apple has confirmed that macOS 27 supports the following Mac models:

  • MacBook Neo – MacBook Neo (2026)
  • MacBook Air – MacBook Air with Apple silicon (2020 and later)
  • MacBook Pro – MacBook Pro with Apple silicon (2020 and later)
  • iMac – iMac with Apple silicon (2021 and later)
  • Mac mini – Mac mini with Apple silicon (2020 and later)
  • Mac Studio – Mac Studio with Apple silicon (2022 and later)
  • Mac Pro – Mac Pro with Apple silicon (2023 and later)

How to enroll in the Apple Developer Program

To receive beta updates on your Mac, you first need to enroll in the Apple Developer Program. Rest assured, there’s no fee involved. Here’s how:

  1. Visit the Apple Developer website.
  2. Sign in with your Apple Account.    
  3. Complete the enrollment process if prompted.

Once enrolled, your Mac will become eligible for developer beta updates.

How to install macOS Golden Gate 27 developer beta 4

Signing up for the Apple Developer Program doesn’t automatically push the macOS 27 developer beta to your Mac. Once you’re enrolled, you still need to turn on developer beta updates in System Settings. After that, macOS 27 Developer Beta should appear in Software Update, ready to download and install.

  1. Open Settings and select General in the sidebar.
  2. Here, click Software Updates.
  3. Now, click the information button next to Beta Updates.
  4. Click Off.
  5. Next, choose the macOS 27 developer beta option and click Done.
  6. Wait for the update to appear.
  7. Click Upgrade Now or Update Now.
  8. Follow the on-screen instructions to complete the installation.

Can’t find the macOS Golden Gate developer beta 4?

If you’ve successfully enrolled in the Apple Developer program but the beta update isn’t showing up, try the following:

  • Make sure you’re signed in with the same Apple Account enrolled in the Developer Program.
  • Restart your Mac and check again.
  • Ensure your Mac is compatible with macOS 27.
  • Wait a little longer, as Apple may take some time to make the update available across all regions.

Should you install macOS Golden Gate developer beta 4?

The macOS 27 developer beta gives you early access to all the new features Apple announced at WWDC 2026, but it comes with the usual beta software trade-offs. You may run into bugs, app compatibility issues, unexpected battery drain, or performance hiccups that can affect day-to-day use.

I usually recommend installing the first developer beta on a secondary Mac if you have one; otherwise, wait for the public beta release. That way, you can try the new features without risking your primary workflow.

How to stop receiving macOS Golden Gate 27 beta 4 updates

If you no longer wish to receive beta updates on your Mac, follow these steps:

  1. Go to Settings → General → Software Updates.
  2. Here, click the information button next to Beta Updates.
  3. Now, click macOS 27 developer beta.
  4. Next, choose the Off option.

After turning off Beta Updates, your Mac will stop receiving future macOS Golden Gate 27 beta builds. You’ll remain on your current beta version until Apple releases a newer public version of macOS. Once a stable release newer than your installed beta becomes available, you can update to it through Software Update without re-enabling beta updates.

If you’d rather leave the beta program immediately and return to a stable version of macOS, you’ll need to erase your Mac and reinstall the latest public release. You can then restore your data using a backup created before installing the macOS 27 developer beta. This is why backing up your Mac before installing beta software is always recommended.

Signing off…

macOS Golden Gate developer beta 4 gives Mac users an even better look at everything Apple announced at WWDC 2026. This build is noticeably more refined than earlier releases, with meaningful improvements to Liquid Glass readability, window shadowing, Siri AI, and Apple Intelligence across core apps. While beta software is never perfect, this is the fastest way to experience the latest features and design changes before the official release lands in September.

If you prefer a smoother ride, the public beta is a safer option for most users.

Have you installed macOS Golden Gate developer beta 4 yet? Let us know what feature you are most excited to try in the comments!

Vikhyat has a bachelor’s degree in Electronic and Communication Engineering and over five years of writing experience. His passion for technology and Apple products led him to the tech writing space, where he specializes in writing App features, How-to guides, and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple users. 

 

About Vikhyat Rishi

  • Vikhyat has over five years of experience writing consumer tech content.
  • During his association with Smartprix and Beebom, Vikhyat has tested, tested, and reviewed numerous gadgets, including but not limited to smartphones, TVs, and more.
  • His passion for technology and Apple products led him to iGeeksBlog, where he specializes in writing How-to and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple enthusiasts.

Experience

Vikhyat embarked on his journey in consumer technology writing in 2019, driven by his passion for technology. He has sharpened his skills through associations with Smartprix and Beebom, where he extensively tested and reviewed various gadgets, focusing mainly on smartphones. Currently, Vikhyat specializes in crafting How-to and troubleshooting guides for the Apple ecosystem at iGeeksBlog. When not typing away on his MacBook Air, he loves exploring the real world.

title.rendered: How to install iPadOS 27 developer beta 4 on iPad

content.rendered:
Apple has officially released iPadOS 27 developer beta 4, and it’s the most polished build yet. Announced at WWDC 2026 and now in its fourth iteration, this beta brings continued refinements on top of the headline features including an upgraded Siri AI experience, expanded Apple Intelligence across apps like Photos, Safari, Shortcuts, Wallet, and Passwords, and a smoother Liquid Glass design with improved opacity, a transparency slider, and more uniform toolbars.

If you want to get hands-on with iPad-specific upgrades like better multitasking, a persistent menu bar, and resizable iPhone apps before the public release, you can install the beta on your iPad in just a few minutes. That said, it’s still an unfinished build. Bugs, app compatibility issues, battery drain, and occasional performance hiccups are all part of the deal during the testing phase, so avoid installing it on your primary iPad.

Ready to jump in? Here’s how to enroll in the iPadOS 27 developer beta program and download beta 4 on your iPad.

What you need before installing iPadOS 27 developer beta 4

Before downloading the beta, make sure:

  • Your iPad is compatible with iPadOS 27. It requires an A14 Bionic chip or newer.
  • You’re signed in with your Apple Account.
  • You have a stable Wi-Fi connection.
  • Your iPad has at least 50% battery or is connected to a charger.
  • You have created a recent backup using iCloud or a computer to be able to downgrade to iPadOS 26 if something goes wrong.

How to download iPadOS 27 developer beta 4

First, you need to enroll in the Apple Beta Software Program from the official website (https://beta.apple.com/) and sign in with your Apple account. Follow these steps directly on your iPad:

  1. Launch the Settings app on your iPad.
  2. Navigate to General and select Software Update.
  3. Tap Beta Updates.
  4. Wait a few seconds for updates to load. From the list of available beta channels, choose iPadOS 27 Developer Beta.
  5. Go back to the previous screen. The iPadOS 27 Developer Beta should now appear as an available update.
  6. Tap Download and Install. Enter your passcode if prompted and accept Apple’s terms and conditions.
  7. Wait for the installation to complete. The update will download, verify, and install automatically.

Your iPad will restart several times during the installation process. Once completed, you’ll be running iPadOS 27 Developer Beta.

iPadOS 27 beta 4 update not showing up?

If the developer beta isn’t appearing:

  • Check Apple Account: Verify that you’re signed into the correct Apple Account under Settings > [your name banner].
  • Restart your iPad: A simple restart often refreshes beta update availability.
  • Check device compatibility: Unsupported iPads won’t receive the update even if Beta Updates are enabled.
  • Wait for Apple’s servers: Developer beta releases can roll out gradually, so availability may vary during the first few hours after launch.

How to stop receiving beta 4 updates

If you later decide to leave the beta program:

  1. Open Settings.
  2. Go to General > Software Update.
  3. Tap Beta Updates.
  4. Select Off.

Your iPad will remain on the installed beta version until Apple releases a newer public version.

Final thoughts

Installing the iPadOS 27 Developer Beta 4 is easier than ever. Apple delivers beta updates directly through the Software Update section, so there’s no need to download profiles or connect to a computer. As long as your iPad is supported and you’re signed in with the appropriate Apple Account, you’re just a few taps away from the latest build.

Beta 4 is a noticeable step up from earlier releases. Performance is smoother, Siri AI is more reliable, and the Liquid Glass design keeps getting more refined with each build. That said, developer betas are built for testing, not daily use. Always back up your iPad before installing so you can safely roll back to a stable version if anything goes wrong.

The public beta is expected soon, with the full release landing in September alongside new iPad hardware. Until then, beta 4 is your best window into what iPadOS 27 will feel like when it ships.

Which iPadOS 27 features are you most excited about? Drop your thoughts in the comments below!

title.rendered: iOS 27 beta 4 hints at an iPhone with two batteries

content.rendered:
Apple may have left another clue about its future iPhone hardware in iOS 27 Developer Beta 4. New Battery Health strings discovered in the latest beta refer to multiple internal batteries instead of the single battery found in every current iPhone model.

The strings were first spotted by Macworld and later confirmed by MacRumors, suggesting Apple is preparing iOS to support an iPhone with more than one internal battery.

Battery Health messages now reference multiple batteries

Current iPhone models display Battery Health messages that refer to a single battery. In iOS 27 Developer Beta 4, however, Apple has updated the wording to use plural references, including messages such as:

  • “The batteries in this iPhone are performing as expected.”
  • “The health of the batteries in this iPhone has significantly degraded.”

Another newly discovered string states that one of the batteries could not be verified as a genuine Apple battery. This suggests iOS is being prepared to identify and monitor the condition of individual battery cells rather than treating the device as having a single battery.

Apple has not explained the reason for these new strings, but their presence strongly suggests the company is laying the software groundwork for future iPhone hardware that includes multiple internal batteries.

Foldable iPhone is the most likely candidate

According to Macworld, the new Battery Health strings are most likely intended for Apple’s long-rumored foldable iPhone, although Apple has not confirmed which device they are designed for.

Previous reports claim Apple’s first foldable iPhone will feature two separate battery cells with capacities of 1,921mAh and 2,962mAh, combining for a total battery capacity of approximately 4,883mAh.

A dual-battery design is common among book-style foldable smartphones because each half of the device typically houses its own battery cell. Apple is widely expected to adopt a similar internal layout for its foldable iPhone.

The updated Battery Health wording also suggests iOS may eventually display the condition of each battery separately, potentially giving users more detailed information about battery health and servicing. Whether this also changes how future foldable iPhones are repaired or how battery replacements are handled remains unknown.

If current rumors prove accurate, Apple’s first foldable iPhone could debut alongside the iPhone 18 Pro lineup later this September.

Would you like Apple to make individual battery cells easier to replace if it launches a foldable iPhone? Let us know in the comments below.

title.rendered: How to install iOS 27 developer beta 4 on iPhone

content.rendered:
Apple has now released iOS 27 developer beta 4, and it’s the most refined build yet. First unveiled at WWDC 2026, iOS 27 brings a rebuilt Siri AI, expanded Apple Intelligence features across Photos, Messages, Safari, Wallet, and Passwords, enhanced child safety protections, and a wide range of speed improvements that make everyday tasks faster, smarter, and more personalized.

Beta 4 adds a genuinely useful Automatic Downloads feature for the Apple TV app, so the next episodes of whatever show you’re watching download automatically and clear themselves once you finish, along with continued Liquid Glass refinements and steady performance gains across the board.

If you’re ready to try iOS 27 early, the installation process is simpler than ever. You no longer need a paid developer account or beta configuration profiles, everything can be done directly from your iPhone in just a few taps. Here’s how to download iOS 27 developer beta 4.

Before you install iOS 27 developer beta 4

There are a few things I always do before installing any developer beta:

  • Create a full iCloud or computer backup.
  • Make sure the iPhone has at least 50% battery.
  • Connect to a reliable Wi-Fi network.
  • Confirm that the device supports iOS 27. It’s available on iPhone 11 and later.
  • Sign in with your Apple Account.

Developer betas are designed for testing, not daily reliability. Unexpected crashes, battery drain, and app compatibility issues are fairly common during the early stages of beta development.

How to install iOS 27 developer beta 4

The entire process takes only a few minutes.

Step 1: Enroll in the Apple Beta Software Program

  1. Open Apple Beta Software Program.
  2. Log in with your Apple account.

Step 2: Enable and install iOS 27 Developer Beta

  1. Go to Settings > General > Software Update.
  2. Here, tap on Beta Updates. Allow your device a few moments to check for available updates.
  3. Select the iOS 27 Developer Beta option on the next menu and tap Back to return to the Software Update screen.
  4. After a few seconds, the iOS 27 Developer Beta update should appear. Finally, tap Download and Install.
  5. Enter your passcode when prompted and accept Apple’s terms.

Your iPhone will download the update and restart automatically. Depending on your internet speed, the process may take anywhere from 15 to 45 minutes. Once the installation is complete, you’ll boot into iOS 27 and can begin exploring the new features.

What if the iOS 27 developer beta 4 doesn’t appear?

This is one of the most common issues people run into. Here are a few troubleshooting steps that usually help:

  • Make sure you’re signed into the correct account that is signed into the Apple Software Beta program.
  • Restart your iPhone. I’ve seen beta updates appear immediately after a simple reboot.
  • Go back to the Beta Updates menu in Settings. Set it to Off, then enable the Developer Beta again.
  • Be patient. When Apple releases a new beta, servers often get overloaded. Sometimes the update appears after waiting a few hours.

Is the iOS 27 developer beta 4 worth installing?

In my experience, that depends entirely on which iPhone you’re using.

Install it if:

  • You enjoy testing new features early.
  • You’re a developer checking app compatibility.
  • You have a secondary iPhone available.
  • You’re comfortable reporting bugs and troubleshooting issues.

Skip it if:

  • This is your only iPhone.
  • You rely on banking, business, or work-related apps.
  • Stability matters more than getting new features early.

The first developer beta is usually the roughest version Apple releases. While it’s exciting to explore what’s new, it’s not uncommon to encounter visual glitches, battery issues, and apps that simply refuse to work correctly.

How to leave the iOS 27 beta 4 program

If you decide the beta experience isn’t for you, turning off future beta updates is easy.

  1. Open Settings, tap General, and select Software Update.
  2. Open Beta Updates.
  3. Choose Off.

Your iPhone will stop receiving future beta builds and will return to the stable release track once Apple publishes the next public version. You can also revert back to iOS 26 if you face severe issues.

Final thoughts

Installing the iOS 27 Developer Beta 4 is now much easier than it was a few years ago. Apple has removed most of the barriers, letting users join the beta program and download the latest build directly through Software Update. No profiles, no paid account needed.

Beta 4 continues to build on a solid foundation, adding small but genuinely handy touches like automatic episode downloads in the Apple TV app on top of the speed and stability gains from earlier betas. If you have a secondary iPhone, this is a great build to explore Apple’s newest innovations well ahead of the official release.

That said, it’s still a developer beta designed for testing, not daily use. If your iPhone is critical for work, school, or daily communication, the public beta is the smarter, safer choice. And the final release isn’t far off, so the wait won’t be long.

  • How to install watchOS 27 developer beta on your Apple Watch
  • How to install iPadOS 27 Developer Beta on iPad

title.rendered: iOS 27 beta 4 fixes Camera, Siri, CarPlay, and more

content.rendered:
Apple has released iOS 27 developer beta 4 for compatible iPhones. The update carries build number 24A5390f and focuses on fixing bugs across Camera, CarPlay, Siri, Safari, Messages, and other parts of the system.

Beta 4 arrives two weeks after iOS 27 beta 3, which added visible changes such as Siri voice customization and Live Recognition. This time, Apple is concentrating on stability rather than another batch of headline features.

What iOS 27 beta 4 fixes

Apple’s release notes list several fixes that iPhone users may notice:

  • Portrait mode should no longer render the background blur incorrectly.
  • Alarms can now be stopped from the Lock Screen without first unlocking the iPhone.
  • CarPlay fixes restore next and previous track buttons on the steering wheel and address silent stereo playback after Spatial Audio content.
  • Safari’s tab bar should no longer disappear from the screen.
  • Messages fixes incorrectly sized GIFs and pasted images, along with garbled HDR screenshots.
  • Files should be more reliable when deleting items from Recently Deleted.
  • Screen Time restrictions should apply correctly to child accounts.
  • A system stability fix addresses devices freezing or restarting while idle.

Apple has also fixed a bug that could leave an iPhone with a deeply discharged battery stuck on the red battery screen. Home Screen customization, Sleep Focus, StandBy clocks, AirPlay connections protected by a PIN, and the clipped Add a Control button in Control Center receive fixes too.

Siri gets a long list of repairs

The Siri section is much longer. Apple says beta 4 fixes failures when sending a confirmed message, creating recurring reminders, opening URLs, starting some calls, and launching Maps navigation through CarPlay.

Contact handling should also be safer. Earlier builds could choose the wrong person when contacts shared a name or even draft a message to an unrelated contact when the requested name did not exist. Apple lists both problems as fixed.

There are still rough edges. Siri may act on every photo returned in a search instead of only the photos you select. It may also read a message from an unknown sender when asked for the latest message, and responses in CarPlay can be slow when the iPhone is hot or the network is poor.

How to install iOS 27 beta 4

If your Apple Account already has access to the developer beta, install the update directly from the iPhone:

  1. Open Settings and go to General > Software Update.
  2. Tap Beta Updates and select iOS 27 Developer Beta.
  3. Return to the Software Update screen.
  4. Tap Update Now when iOS 27 beta 4 appears.

Back up the iPhone first, keep it connected to Wi-Fi, and plug it into power during installation. Our iOS 27 developer beta installation guide covers the enrollment process and what to try if the update does not appear.

Beta 4 is currently a developer release. If you are using the first iOS 27 public beta, stay on the public beta channel and wait for Apple to release the next build there. At the time of writing, Apple has not announced a matching public beta update.

Even with this many fixes, iOS 27 remains unfinished software. A secondary iPhone is still the safer place to test it, especially if you depend on CarPlay, banking apps, or your phone for work.

title.rendered: How to get Batman Sprite in Fortnite: All locations

content.rendered:
With Fortnite’s Hot Bat Summer promotion in full swing, the Batman Sprite has recently entered the fray and become yet another name for players to add to their list of sprites. This one grants a unique ability for players, allowing them to launch into the air with the Bat Cape equipped.

Apart from grabbing Batman Sprite by going on a chest hunt or by completing quests, you can also get it by dueling with either Catwoman, Poison Ivy, or Harley Quinn, all of whom can be found in certain parts of the map. While the base Batman Sprite can be obtained through winning these duels, other variants of the sprite—such as the Galaxy one—can only be obtained through opening chests.

Read on to find out the details of where you can encounter the aforementioned DC villains and kick off a duel with them, in order to get the Batman Sprite. Also, it’s important to note that there is a possibility that other players may already be at a given villain’s location when you reach it. So, be prepared to take care of such surprise encounters.

How to find Catwoman in Fortnite

Towards the south of Wonkeeland and north-east of the Frosted Flats, there is a beach lining the coast. Once there, go to the location marked in the image above, and there you will find Catwoman.

When you encounter Batman’s feline foe, walk up to her and press the interact button. Then, make sure to pick the “Duel: Challenge Catwoman” option and confirm your decision. This will start your face-off with Catwoman.

During the battle, Catwoman will use an SMG to fire at you and also use her agile moves to dodge your fire. Make sure to keep an eye on her shield and health as well as yours and take her down through a coordinated attack. Once you defeat her, she will drop Catwoman’s Rapid Fire SMG and occasionally a Batman Sprite as well.

How to find Poison Ivy in Fortnite

West of the Lifty Lodge and towards the northern part of The Battlewoods lies a small island connected by a single bridge. On the southern tip of that island, as demarcated above, you will come across Poison Ivy standing on ground covered with small rocks and pebbles.

Walk up to the femme fatale and interact with the option, “Duel: Challenge Poison Ivy”. Once you confirm your decision, Ivy will turn hostile and start attacking you.

During this fight, Ivy will rely on pistols and stink grenades. Based on that, you must ensure not to spend too long in the gas cloud when she deploys a grenade. There is also a healing mechanic that replenishes the villain’s health from time to time. So, try to not give her enough time to recover in the midst of battle. After the fight is won, you can obtain Poison Ivy’s Ranger Pistol and sometimes even a Batman Sprite from her.

How to find Harley Quinn in Fortnite

In the south-west corner of the Sinister Strip area, you will see a sandy spot in between lush vegetation. Harley Quinn can be found right there, waiting to be spotted, near some inflatable toys floating in the river.

Go to Quinn and interact to select the “Duel: Challenge Harley Quinn” option. Once you confirm your decision, a boss fight will commence immediately.

During the face-off, Harley Quinn will use her assault rifle and occasionally grenades to take you out. For that reason, don’t just shoot at your target but also pay attention to any throwables that come your way. After you successfully vanquish her, she will drop Harley Quinn’s Warforged AR and, at times, a Batman Sprite for you to claim.

Getting Batman Sprite from other players

Steal it from another player

Sometimes, the easier way to get your hands on a sprite is not to track it down or fight a boss for it but to simply snatch it from an opponent. To do this, check the backs of the players you find in the lobby to see if they are carrying any desirable sprite.

If you do find someone like that, once the match begins, keep an eye on when he exits the Battle Bus. Then, chase after him and eliminate him to claim the sprite for your own.

Index it from a friend

Visit Fortnite’s official Discord and go to the “sprite-runners-network” channel. There, you can find other players who already own a sprite, willing to let others index it from them. This act involves temporarily borrowing the desired sprite from another player during a match, extracting it (so that it appears in your sprite collection), and then returning it.

Wrapping up

Throughout the Runners season, sprites have been a big draw among Fortnite fans. The newer sprites, such as Batman Sprite and Vini Jr Sprite, have thrown into the mix a few unique sprites based on popular figures. Interestingly, these sprites even have abilities modeled after their respective figures.

In the coming days, it will be interesting to see what Epic Games has next in store. Personally, I’m intrigued about the chances of more sprites inspired by fictional and real personalities making their way into the game. There have been some leaks about a Spider-Man sprite, so I have my hopes up for an addition like that to drop soon.

  • How to get American Dad skins in Fortnite

title.rendered: Samsung launches Galaxy Card with 5% cash back to rival Apple Card

content.rendered:
Samsung has launched its first credit card in the U.S., giving Galaxy users an Apple Card-style option built around Samsung Wallet. The new Samsung Galaxy Card is issued by Barclays on the Visa network and has no annual fee.

The card is available virtually through Samsung Wallet and as a black metal physical card. General applications open in the U.S. on July 22, while eligible early-access customers can already apply.

Galaxy Card rewards favor Samsung Wallet users

Samsung’s reward structure is more generous when cardholders stay inside its ecosystem:

  • 5% cash rewards on eligible purchases made directly through Samsung
  • 3% on purchases made with Samsung Wallet
  • 2% on eligible streaming services, including Netflix, Disney+, and Spotify
  • 1% on other purchases

The 5% tier covers channels such as Samsung.com, Samsung Experience Stores, the Shop Samsung app, Galaxy Store, Care+, Samsung Secure Wi-Fi, Samsung Smart TV Store, and SmartThings Videos.

New qualifying cardholders can also earn $200 after spending $2,000 within the first 90 days. Samsung is offering 20% off a Samsung VIP Advantage purchase or renewal, along with 5% cash rewards on that transaction. Terms apply to these offers.

The 3% Samsung Wallet rate requires a compatible phone running Android 9.0 or later and a Samsung account. That makes the card’s best everyday reward most useful to people who already pay with a Galaxy device.

Galaxy Card offers more cash back than Apple Card in key areas

The Apple Card pays 3% Daily Cash at Apple and select merchants when using Apple Pay, 2% on other Apple Pay purchases, and 1% with the physical titanium card. Galaxy Card raises those comparable rates to 5% on eligible direct Samsung purchases and 3% through Samsung Wallet.

Apple’s card still has broader built-in financial features, including Apple Card Family, interest-free monthly installments on eligible Apple products, and an optional Apple Card Savings account. Apple has also said those benefits will remain during the planned transition from Goldman Sachs to Chase.

Galaxy Card’s strongest pitch is straightforward: people who regularly buy Samsung products or use Samsung Wallet can earn more cash back. Outside that ecosystem, its 1% base rate is much less compelling.

excerpt.rendered: Samsung’s first U.S. credit card offers up to 5% cash back, a $200 welcome bonus, no annual fee, and tight integration with Samsung Wallet for Galaxy users.

title.rendered: I tried to see who shared my Facebook post: Here’s what Facebook actually shows

content.rendered:
One of my Facebook posts suddenly started getting more likes and comments than usual. Friends were tagging each other, new people were reacting, and the reach kept climbing. And, obviously, the first question for me was: who shared my Facebook post?

I assumed Facebook would show a neat list of everyone who clicked the Share button. It didn’t. If you’ve been wondering whether you can see who shared your Facebook post, here’s exactly what Facebook shows, and what it doesn’t.

Can you see who shared your Facebook post?

Yes, but only sometimes.

You can see who shared your Facebook post only if the share is public or visible to you.

You cannot see locked profile shares, shares made with custom audiences, or shares inside private Facebook groups where you aren’t a member.

That limitation isn’t a bug. It’s how Facebook’s privacy system is designed.

How to see who has shared your Facebook post

The steps are quite tricky. Here’s what you need to do:

On Android:

  1. Open Facebook on your mobile and tap your profile picture.
  2. Go to the post you need to see the sharer for.
  3. Tap the Comment icon. It will open the comment box and show the number of shares at the top right corner.
  4. Now, tap the share number to see who actually reposted your Facebook post.
  5. You will get a list of sharers.

You can use this method for any post on your news feed.

On iPhone:

  1. Go to the post on your Facebook profile and open the comment box.
  2. You will see the Share count. Tap on it to see all the reposts with the sharers’ captions and the reactions on their posts.

If you have a professional account, you will see an eye icon with the viewer count under every post. Tap it to see the post’s performance analytics. Scroll down and select Shares. It will show you who has shared your post.

Note: I tested it on desktop, and surprisingly, it only shows who has reacted to the post unless they have hidden the likes. There was no way to open the sharer count list.

What happened when I checked my Facebook post

I opened one of my public posts that had already received a few shares. I clicked the Share count beneath the post, assuming it would reveal the people who had reposted it. Instead, Facebook showed the share sheet to repost it. Then research led me to the actual steps.

In my case, I could see a few shares that were made publicly. When someone had shared the post with a public audience, their shared post was visible, and I could open it to see their caption and any public comments. However, several of the shares were missing even though the share count was higher than the number of visible shared posts.

At first I assumed Facebook wasn’t loading correctly. It wasn’t a loading issue. Those missing shares simply weren’t visible to me.

What Facebook actually shows

When you click the share count on an eligible post, Facebook may display:

  • Public shares
  • Posts shared by friends (if their audience includes you)
  • Shares on public timelines
  • Public pages that reshared your content

You’ll usually see:

  • The person’s name
  • Their caption (if added)
  • When they shared it
  • Reactions and comments on that public share

If the share isn’t public, Facebook hides it completely. Not even the original author gets special access.

Why you can’t see every share

This is where many people get confused. Facebook protects the privacy settings chosen by the person doing the sharing—not the creator of the original post.

If someone shared your post with Friends, Only Me, a private group, or another audience you don’t have access to, Facebook doesn’t reveal their name or their shared post. Also, if someone shared the post via Messenger, it’s end-to-end invisible. All of these shares still contribute to the overall share count, but they remain hidden from you.

I also tested this with another account’s public post. The result was the same. I could only view publicly shared versions of the post, while the rest stayed invisible.

The biggest takeaway from my test was simple: Facebook lets you see some shares, not every share. If you’re expecting a complete list of everyone who clicked Share, Facebook doesn’t currently provide that information.

Final thoughts

I went into this expecting Facebook to give me a complete list of everyone who shared my post. Instead, the platform draws a hard line between engagement and privacy.

At first, that felt frustrating. If it’s my post, why shouldn’t I know where it’s being shared? However, after further research, it becomes obvious that when someone is sharing your content, he or she becomes responsible for audience and privacy settings.

So if your post says it has 50 shares, but you can only see 12, don’t assume Facebook is broken. In most cases, the missing shares are simply happening in places you’re not allowed to access.

title.rendered: My Squishy Box Store codes (July 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest My Squishy Box Store codes on July 27, 2026

Cash disappears quickly when you are opening Mystery Boxes and chasing Secret, Shiny, or Mythic Dumpling Squishies. These codes give you enough of a head start to open more boxes and grow your shop sooner.

The free rewards help you keep rolling without spending as much time farming cash, making it easier to expand your collection and unlock rarer Squishies. Since Roblox developers often release and expire codes alongside new updates, you should redeem them as soon as possible. I’ll keep this guide updated with the latest working and expired Dumpling Squishies codes so you never miss out on free rewards.

All working My Squishy Box Store codes

  • NewFloor: 500 Cash (NEW)
  • Update3: 500 Cash (NEW)
  • Dumpling: 1,000 Cash
  • WELCOME: 500 Cash

These are the codes worth trying now. Copy each one exactly as shown because a typo or extra space can block the reward.

Expired My Squishy Box Store codes

There are no confirmed expired codes yet. If one fails, try it once in a fresh server before writing it off.

How to redeem My Squishy Box Store codes

The code menu stays locked until you complete the opening tutorial.

  1. Open My Squishy Box Store on Roblox.
  2. Finish the opening tutorial.
  3. Select the code button or press the J key.
  4. Paste a working code into the Enter your code here! box.
  5. Select OK to claim the Cash.

Why your My Squishy Box Store code is not working

Most failed redemptions come down to the code, your account, or the server:

  • The code has an extra space or an incorrect capital letter.
  • You have already redeemed the reward on the same Roblox account.
  • You have not finished the tutorial, so the code menu is still locked.
  • The code expired after an update or event.
  • Your server is running an older version of the experience.
  • Roblox or the game is having a temporary issue.

Copy and paste the code instead of typing it. If it still fails, leave the experience, join a new server, and try once more.

Where to find more My Squishy Box Store codes

New codes are most likely to arrive with shop updates, new mystery boxes, milestones, seasonal events, or bug-fix rewards. Watch the My Squishy Box Store Roblox page and join the Dumpling Market community for developer announcements.

Bookmark this page if you want the working list without digging through old community posts after every update.

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Slime RNG codes, Clean the Squishies codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

title.rendered: I found the best way to make my Instagram Following list more private

content.rendered:
I never paid much attention to my Instagram Following list until friends would mention accounts I followed for fun. Then I realized even people I barely knew might be snooping on my list. That curiosity led me to look for a way to hide my Instagram Following list.

Initially, I expected there should be an option to make it private. But after doing some research and experimenting with various methods, there was no easy way to do that. If you’re hoping to make your Instagram Following list private, here’s what I learned and the privacy changes that genuinely made a difference.

Can you actually hide your Instagram Following list?

Let’s clear up the biggest misconception first. No, Instagram does not currently let you completely hide your Following list.

There’s no hidden setting that suddenly makes your Following list invisible. Instead, Instagram gives you something different: control over who can access your account. That’s an important distinction.

Here’s how it actually works:

  • If your Instagram account is public, almost anyone can visit your profile and see the accounts you follow.
  • For private accounts, only people you’ve approved as followers can see your profile details, including your Following list.

That doesn’t mean your Following list disappears. It simply becomes visible to a much smaller audience.

Honestly, I think Instagram designed it this way on purpose. Followers and Following lists help people discover mutual friends, creators, and communities. While that improves engagement, it also means privacy isn’t as flexible as many users would like.

Would I love a dedicated Hide Following List option? Absolutely. But until Instagram adds one, the smartest approach is reducing who can see your profile.

Why I wanted my Following list to be more private

Everyone has different reasons for wanting more privacy.

Mine wasn’t about hiding anything. It was about creating healthier boundaries. As I started using Instagram more, I noticed that people started treating Following lists like a sort of investigation process. Instead of engaging with someone’s content, they’d scroll through who that person followed.

I have seen cases where people have been judged due to following a competitor, friendships questioned over a single follow, and even people make assumptions about someone’s interests based on a handful of accounts.

Social media has normalized investigating everyone else’s network, and I think that’s unhealthy. Just because someone follows an account doesn’t automatically mean they endorse every opinion, product, or post from that creator. Eventually I decided to make my account feel like my space again.

4 ways to make your Instagram Following list more private

After trying nearly every recommendation on Instagram’s Help Center, I narrowed everything down to four methods that actually improved my privacy.

1. Switch your account to private

A private Instagram account reduces who could browse your profile. Instead of anyone opening my account and exploring my Following list, people now had to send a follow request first.

That single step added an important layer of control. I could decide who gets access to my profile.

How to make your Instagram account private:

  1. Open Instagram.
  2. Tap your profile picture at the bottom.
  3. Open the hamburger menu in the top-right corner. It will open Settings and activity.
  4. Select Account privacy.
  5. Toggle on Private account and confirm your choice by tapping Switch to private.

That’s it. From that point forward, new visitors can’t automatically view your profile unless you approve them.

One thing I appreciate is that existing followers don’t suddenly disappear. However, they do continue to have access to your Following list. That’s why switching to private is only the beginning, not the complete solution.

2. Remove unwanted followers

This was the step I resisted the longest.

Removing followers felt awkward. What if someone noticed, or they asked why? Eventually, I realized something important. My Instagram account exists for me—not for everyone who’s ever clicked the Follow button.

For this reason, I spent about fifteen minutes going through my followers and found inactive profiles, people I couldn’t even remember, spam accounts, and old connections I’d completely lost touch with. I removed them.

  1. Open your profile on Instagram.
  2. Tap on Followers to view the list.
  3. Scroll down and tap the x icon next to the follower you want to remove.
  4. Select Remove to confirm.

Worry not; Instagram doesn’t send any notifications to those users.

3. Block specific people

Making my account private helped a lot, but there were still a few people I didn’t want checking my profile. If someone is making you uncomfortable or repeatedly stalking your profile, you may block them on Instagram.

Once you block someone, they can’t :

  • Find your profile while logged into their account.
  • See your posts, Stories, followers, or Following list.
  • Message or interact with your account.

Simply go to the Instagram profile of that user, tap the three-dot icon, and select Block.

    • Blocking might seem like a big step, but sometimes it’s the simplest way to protect your privacy. There’s no reason to keep giving someone access if they’ve crossed your personal boundaries.

    4. Reviewing my followers regularly

    One habit that has made a bigger difference than I expected is reviewing my followers every few months. It’s easy to accept follow requests and forget about them. With time, you will find your followers’ list full of people you do not know or inactive accounts.

    Now, I make it a point to scroll through my followers occasionally and ask myself a few simple questions:

    • Do I know this person?
    • Do I still feel comfortable sharing my content with them?
    • Would I approve their follow request today?

    If the answer is no, I remove them.

    This isn’t about being unfriendly. It’s about remembering that a private Instagram account works best when your follower list actually reflects people you trust.

    What didn’t work (Common myths)

    While researching ways to hide my Instagram Following list, I came across plenty of advice that sounded convincing, but simply wasn’t true. Here are the biggest myths I found.

    Myth 1: Third-party apps can hide your Following list

    Some apps claim they can unlock extra Instagram privacy features. In reality, they can’t change how Instagram works.

    Many of these apps ask for your Instagram login credentials, which can put your account at risk. Even if an app promises to hide your Following list, it has no control over Instagram’s privacy settings. It’s simply not worth the risk.

    Myth 2: Browser extensions add extra privacy

    Several browser extensions claim that they can either hide your followers or your list of Following.

    What they actually do is change how Instagram looks on your own screen. Other people still see your profile normally, so these extensions don’t provide any real privacy.

    Myth 3: Switching back to a personal account hides your Following list

    Changing between a Creator, Business, or Personal account doesn’t affect who can see your Following list.

    The setting that matters most is whether your account is public or private.

    My best tips for keeping an Instagram profile more private

    While these privacy settings don’t hide your Following list, they make your overall Instagram experience noticeably more private.

    • Hide your Activity Status: I disabled Activity Status almost immediately. People don’t need to know exactly when I’m online.
    • Use Close Friends more often: Instead of posting everything publicly, I began using the Close Friends option for my personal posts. This trick really helped me feel more comfortable while posting Stories.
    • Limit comments and messages: Instagram lets you control who can comment, mention you, tag you, and send message requests. These settings reduce unwanted attention across your account.
    • Review tagged photos: I also enabled manual approval for tagged posts. That way nothing appears on my profile unless I approve it first.
    • Be selective about follow requests: Don’t feel pressured to accept every request. It’s okay to ignore or decline requests from people you don’t know.

    After trying different privacy settings and testing what actually works, these are the habits I’ve decided to stick with.

    Protect your Instagram connections!

    While Instagram doesn’t let you completely hide your Following list, you can still make it much more private by using the settings that are available. Switching to a private account, removing followers you don’t recognize, and blocking people when necessary are the most effective ways to control who can see your profile.

    What really matters is sticking to what you can control, rather than trying to make something impossible happen. A couple of easy-to-follow privacy tips will help you use Instagram with more confidence.

    Don’t miss these related reads:

    • Instagram Plus: New features, price, and everything we know so far
    • Instagram carousel posts get a long-requested caption feature
    • Instagram’s new AI voice effects let you change your voice in DMs

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Slime RNG codes on July 28, 2026

Rolling for rare slimes gets expensive fast, so a free Big Dice and Currency Boost can save a chunk of early grinding. Redeem the working codes below before the next update changes the list.

Using these freebies gives you more chances to roll stronger slimes and earn extra currency, helping you progress much faster in the early game. Since Roblox developers regularly add new codes and expire old ones during updates, it’s worth claiming every reward as soon as possible. I’ll keep this guide updated with the latest working and expired codes, so you always know which ones are still active.

All working Slime RNG codes

  • gullible: 1 Coin

These are the two codes currently worth redeeming. Copy them exactly because capitalization matters.

Expired Slime RNG codes

WHEELIE, bigboss, dinoStomp, beammeup, fruitfeast, spin2win, slimeTime, aliensarehere, AAisComing, Sliming, goingBananas, test, outofthisworld, AATOMORROW, BONUSbonusBONUS, giveMeLuckNOW, 2muchluck, craftAway, time2Grind, SPARKLEZ, mutationPLS, Release!, stonks, moonSlimeNoWay2, Semils, GOFAST, SUPERL00T, SUNOB, RAWRRRR, THATSHUGE

The following codes are expired, limited, or no longer confirmed by the freshest checks. You can try a disputed code once, but do not keep retrying it if the game rejects it.

How to redeem Slime RNG codes

The code box is tucked at the bottom of the Shop. New players may need to finish the short tutorial before it becomes available.

  1. Open Slime RNG on Roblox.
  2. Finish the tutorial if prompted.
  3. Select Shop on the right.
  4. Scroll to the code box at the bottom.
  5. Paste a working code.
  6. Select Redeem to claim the reward.

Why your Slime RNG code is not working

Check the code and server before giving up. Most failed redemptions come down to one of these reasons:

  • The code has expired or reached a limited redemption cap.
  • A letter is in the wrong case, or an extra space was pasted.
  • You already claimed the code on your Roblox account.
  • Your server is still running an older game version.
  • You have not completed the tutorial yet.

Copy-paste the code first. If a newly released code still fails, leave the experience, join a fresh server, and try it once more.

Where to find more Slime RNG codes

New rewards usually appear around updates, milestones, or limited events. Check the Stouts Studio Discord, the Stouts Studio Roblox community, and developer Leif on X when a patch lands.

You can also bookmark this page for the cleaned-up list instead of testing every old string posted in Discord.

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Clean the Squishies codes, Blade Ball codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

title.rendered: Report: Apple canceled two Mac Pro models before discontinuing the lineup

content.rendered:
Apple reportedly developed two unreleased Mac Pro models before deciding to discontinue the desktop earlier this year. According to Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman, the company explored multiple paths for the Mac Pro, including an Intel-powered version and an Apple silicon model, before ultimately canceling the lineup.

Apple announced in March that it was discontinuing the Mac Pro and confirmed it had no plans to release future Mac Pro hardware. With that decision, the Mac Studio became Apple’s most powerful desktop computer.

Apple reportedly built Intel and Apple silicon Mac Pro prototypes

In the latest edition of his Power On newsletter, Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman reports that Apple had two Mac Pro models in development under the codenames J170 and J190, but neither device ever reached the market.

The more surprising prototype was J170, an Intel-based Mac Pro. Despite Apple’s transition to Apple silicon, the company reportedly continued developing an Intel version to support professional users who still depended on Intel-specific software, workflows, and hardware compatibility.

The second prototype, internally known as J190, was powered by Apple’s M3 Ultra chip. It was originally expected to launch alongside the M3 Ultra Mac Studio in early 2025 before Apple canceled the project ahead of discontinuing the Mac Pro altogether.

According to Gurman, Apple was also developing M2 Extreme and M3 Extreme chips as part of its long-term silicon roadmap. These processors were designed to sit above the Ultra series, giving the Mac Pro a significant performance advantage over the Mac Studio.

However, Apple reportedly abandoned the Extreme chips because they were expensive to develop, difficult to manufacture, and expected to serve only a small niche of professional users.

Mac Studio is now Apple’s flagship desktop

With the Mac Pro officially discontinued, the Mac Studio now serves as Apple’s highest-end desktop for professional users.

Gurman does not expect Apple to revive the Mac Pro anytime soon, if ever. Instead, Apple is reportedly focusing its desktop strategy on future Mac Studio models.

According to the report, the company is already working on new Mac Studio models powered by the M5 Ultra chip, which could debut as early as this fall.

While the Mac Pro has long been Apple’s most expandable and powerful desktop, the company’s decision suggests it now believes the Mac Studio can meet the needs of the vast majority of professional users without maintaining a separate, ultra-high-end product line.

Would you like to see Apple bring back the Mac Pro with a future Extreme chip, or is the Mac Studio powerful enough for today’s professional workflows? Let us know in the comments below.

excerpt.rendered: A new report claims Apple developed Intel and M3 Ultra Mac Pro prototypes before canceling both projects and discontinuing the Mac Pro lineup earlier this year.

title.rendered: Apple is testing AI to record and summarize Genius Bar sessions

content.rendered:
Apple is reportedly testing a new AI-powered feature called Live Notes at select retail stores that can record, transcribe, and summarize conversations between customers and the Genius Bar. The feature is currently being piloted at a small number of locations to reduce the amount of time employees spend taking notes during support appointments.

The details come from Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman, who reports that the AI-generated transcript is saved to Apple’s internal Genius Bar system after each session. Apple believes the feature will allow employees to spend more time assisting customers instead of manually documenting everything discussed during an appointment.

Live Notes requires consent from both customers and employees

According to Bloomberg, Live Notes is an opt-in feature for both customers and Apple Store employees. A Genius Bar appointment is recorded only if both parties explicitly agree, and the audio recording itself is not permanently stored.

Instead, the AI creates a transcript and summary that employees can review, edit, and approve before saving them to Apple’s internal support system. Bloomberg reports that Apple added this workflow to address privacy concerns raised by some employees during testing.

Even with those safeguards in place, some employees are reportedly still uncomfortable with the feature. According to Bloomberg, they are concerned that AI-generated transcripts could eventually be used for employee coaching or performance evaluations, even though Apple says the recordings are deleted, managers cannot access the transcripts, and only the finalized support notes are saved to the company’s internal systems.

Apple hasn’t decided whether the feature will expand

The Live Notes system is still in the testing phase and is not mandatory for Apple Store employees. Bloomberg says it remains unclear whether Apple plans to expand the feature to additional retail locations, require employees to use it, or change how transcripts are handled as the pilot progresses.

For now, Apple is limiting the trial to a small number of Apple Stores while it evaluates the feature and gathers feedback from employees and customers. Whether Live Notes eventually becomes a standard part of Genius Bar appointments or remains an experimental tool has yet to be decided.

If Apple expands the feature more broadly, it could make support appointments faster and more consistent by automatically documenting conversations while allowing employees to focus on solving customer issues rather than taking notes.

Would you be comfortable allowing AI to transcribe your Genius Bar appointment if it resulted in faster, more accurate support? Let us know in the comments below.

His passion for technology and Apple products led him to the tech writing space, where he specializes in writing App features, How-to guides, and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple users. 

 

About Vikhyat Rishi

  • Vikhyat has over five years of experience writing consumer tech content.
  • During his association with Smartprix and Beebom, Vikhyat has tested, tested, and reviewed numerous gadgets, including but not limited to smartphones, TVs, and more.
  • His passion for technology and Apple products led him to iGeeksBlog, where he specializes in writing How-to and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple enthusiasts.

Experience

Vikhyat embarked on his journey in consumer technology writing in 2019, driven by his passion for technology. He has sharpened his skills through associations with Smartprix and Beebom, where he extensively tested and reviewed various gadgets, focusing mainly on smartphones. Currently, Vikhyat specializes in crafting How-to and troubleshooting guides for the Apple ecosystem at iGeeksBlog. When not typing away on his MacBook Air, he loves exploring the real world.

title.rendered: Apple Music and Apple One just got more expensive

content.rendered:
Apple has raised U.S. prices for every Apple Music plan and two Apple One bundles. The changes took effect on July 17, adding between $1 and $3 to Apple Music and $2 to the affected Apple One plans.

The increase is part of a wider round of pricing changes covering several countries and products, according to a MacRumors roundup. In the U.S., however, Apple Music and Apple One are the only services affected by this latest move.

New Apple Music prices in the U.S.

Apple’s U.S. pricing page now lists the following monthly rates:

The Family plan sees the largest increase, rising nearly 18%. It still supports up to six people through Family Sharing, making the effective cost about $3.33 per person when fully shared.

The plans keep the same features, including ad-free listening, offline downloads, lossless audio, Spatial Audio, and Apple Music Classical.

Apple told Music Business Worldwide that rising licensing costs were behind the increase. This is the first Apple Music price hike since October 2022.

Apple One Family and Premier rise by $2

Apple also changed the prices of two Apple One bundles, but left its entry-level plan alone:

Apple One Individual is now $7.96 more than Apple Music Individual. That extra amount adds Apple TV, Apple Arcade, and 50GB of iCloud+ storage, so the unchanged bundle may look better to subscribers who already pay for more than one Apple service.

Family includes the same four services with 200GB of iCloud+ storage for up to six people. Premier adds 2TB of storage, Apple Fitness+, and Apple News+.

iCloud+ and iPhone prices are unchanged in the U.S.

Apple raised iCloud+ prices in Nigeria, Türkiye, Vietnam, Japan, Egypt, New Zealand, the Philippines, and Indonesia. U.S. iCloud+ prices remain at $0.99 for 50GB, $2.99 for 200GB, and $9.99 for 2TB per month. The larger 6TB and 12TB plans also remain $29.99 and $59.99. Our iCloud+ explainer covers what each storage tier includes.

The company also raised iPhone prices by roughly 8% to 11% in Japan, but there is no matching increase in the U.S. iPhone store.

This follows Apple’s June decision to raise prices on Macs, iPads, Vision Pro, Apple TV, and HomePod. Apple blamed those hardware increases on soaring memory and storage costs driven by AI data-center demand. The Apple Music increase has a separate cause: licensing costs.

On an iPhone, existing subscribers can check their next renewal price by opening Settings, tapping their name, and selecting Subscriptions. If the higher rate no longer feels worthwhile, they can change or cancel the subscription before the next billing date.

title.rendered: I tried Google Photos Remix, and it made my Old photo library fun again

content.rendered:
I have thousands of photos sitting in Google Photos, and I couldn’t tell you what half of them are. Old vacation pictures, forgotten screenshots, memes, and selfies I haven’t looked at in years are all buried somewhere in my library.

While browsing Google Photos recently, I came across Remix, an AI-powered feature that gives existing photos a completely new look. It finally gave me a reason to revisit images I’d forgotten about and see what I could create with them.

I tried all three Remix categories: Reimagine, Art Styles, and Filters using different photos. Not every result impressed me, especially when AI had to recreate faces or fine details, but a few turned out well enough that I actually wanted to keep them.

What is Google Photos Remix?

Remix lets you take any photo already saved in Google Photos and give it a completely different look using AI. All you need to do is pick a photo and choose one of the available presets. Google Photos creates a new AI-generated version while leaving your original image untouched.

The feature is divided into three categories: Reimagine, Art Styles, and Filters. Reimagine can place you in a completely different setting or turn you into something like a collectible figurine. Art Styles recreates photos as sketches, paintings, or illustrations, while Filters focuses on photographic looks such as film grain and vintage effects.

You can use Remix for simple edits, such as giving an old vacation photo a film look, or change the image entirely. For example, one of the available presets can turn a casual selfie into a professional-looking headshot.

How to use Google Photos Remix

Using Remix only takes a few taps:

  1. Open the Google Photos app and head to the Create tab.
  2. Here, tap Remix.
  3. Now, choose your preferred category: Reimagine, Art Styles, or Filters.
  4. Next, select the template you want to try.
  5. Choose a photo from your library, then tap Generate.
  6. Wait for Google Photos to generate the new image.
  7. Once it’s ready, you can save or share the image if you like the result.
  8. If you don’t like it, tap Regenerate to try again.

What each Google Photos Remix category does

Although Google puts all three options under Remix, they don’t have much in common once you start using them. Reimagine makes the biggest changes to a photo, Art Styles turns it into different forms of artwork, while Filters stick to more familiar photo effects.

Reimagine: The most creative Remix mode

The Collectible Figurine preset was the first one I tried, and it quickly became my favorite. It transformed an ordinary photo into a miniature figure placed inside an entirely new scene.

You can also try a professional headshot, a dramatic black-and-white portrait, or a fashion photo shoot. Of all the presets, the Professional Headshot template felt the most practical. It turned an ordinary selfie into something that genuinely looked suitable for a LinkedIn profile or professional profile picture.

Reimagine can get things wrong, though. Faces occasionally looked strange in my results, and smaller details sometimes came back looking nothing like the original. I still ended up running quite a few photos through it, mostly because I never really knew what I was going to get back.

Art Styles: Turn your photos into artwork

I had better luck with Art Styles when using photos that already looked good on their own. Rather than rebuilding the entire image, these presets change how the existing photo looks.

I spent the most time experimenting with Pen Sketch, Soft Watercolor, Chibi Sticker, and Oil Masterpiece. Watercolor and sketch worked particularly well on my travel photos. Chibi, on the other hand, made more sense when there was a person in the shot.

The original photo also remained much easier to recognize here. That’s probably why I preferred Art Styles for photos I actually cared about, since I could change their appearance without losing too much of what I liked about the original.

Filters: Quick film and vintage effects

Filters will feel familiar if you’ve used almost any photo-editing app before. Remix includes options such as Sun-Worn Vintage, Film Grain, and Instant Film with Flash.

Most of the time, I used these on travel shots to give them an older film-camera look. The results weren’t as entertaining as seeing myself turned into a figurine or an illustration, but I also knew roughly what the finished photo would look like before applying the effect.

I’d use Filters when I already like a photo and only want to change its overall look. They leave the image itself mostly alone, which makes them the safest of the three Remix options.

Which Google Photos Remix mode is worth using?

After testing all three categories, Art Styles is the one I’d probably keep coming back to. It gives photos a noticeably different look while still keeping enough of the original image intact.

Reimagine was more fun to play around with. The collectible figurine and professional headshot templates are probably the first ones I’d show someone who hasn’t tried Remix before. The results aren’t always consistent, though, especially when faces or smaller details are involved.

Filters are much simpler by comparison. They work well when I just want to give a photo a quick film or vintage look, but plenty of other apps already do the same thing. It’s nice to have those options built into Google Photos, but they’re not the reason I’d open Remix.

If I had to keep just one category, I’d go with Art Styles. But if I wanted to show someone what Remix can actually do, I’d start with Reimagine.

Is Google Photos Remix worth trying?

Remix won’t replace my regular editing workflow. If I need to fix exposure, remove distractions, or make detailed edits, I’ll still rely on Google Photos’ standard editing tools.

What surprised me most was how Remix encouraged me to revisit photos I’d completely forgotten about. Instead of scrolling past old memories, I found myself wondering how they’d look as paintings, figurines, sketches, or vintage film shots.

My Google Photos library is still just as cluttered as before, but Remix has made digging through those forgotten memories a lot more enjoyable.

excerpt.rendered: Google Photos Remix helped me rediscover forgotten photos with AI-generated styles, headshots, and artistic effects. After testing every mode, here’s the one I’d actually keep using.

Vikhyat has a bachelor’s degree in Electronic and Communication Engineering and over five years of writing experience. His passion for technology and Apple products led him to the tech writing space, where he specializes in writing App features, How-to guides, and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple users. 

 

About Vikhyat Rishi

  • Vikhyat has over five years of experience writing consumer tech content.
  • During his association with Smartprix and Beebom, Vikhyat has tested, tested, and reviewed numerous gadgets, including but not limited to smartphones, TVs, and more.
  • His passion for technology and Apple products led him to iGeeksBlog, where he specializes in writing How-to and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple enthusiasts.

Experience

Vikhyat embarked on his journey in consumer technology writing in 2019, driven by his passion for technology. He has sharpened his skills through associations with Smartprix and Beebom, where he extensively tested and reviewed various gadgets, focusing mainly on smartphones. Currently, Vikhyat specializes in crafting How-to and troubleshooting guides for the Apple ecosystem at iGeeksBlog. When not typing away on his MacBook Air, he loves exploring the real world.

title.rendered: How to get Stranger Things skins in Fortnite

content.rendered:
Netflix’s hit series Stranger Things has finally arrived in Fortnite through the Item Shop, bringing a lineup of skins based on fan-favorite characters such as Eleven, Dustin, Lucas, Mike, Will, and Chief Hopper. Iconic villains like the Demogorgon and Vecna have also joined the collaboration, alongside a wide range of themed cosmetics.

At the time of writing, the Stranger Things cosmetics are available in the Fortnite Item Shop until July 19, 2026, at 5 PM PT / 8 PM ET. Most character outfits cost 1,500 V-Bucks, while the Demogorgon outfit is priced at 1,200 V-Bucks.

Steps to claim Stranger Things skins in Fortnite

Follow the steps below to purchase your preferred Stranger Things skin.

  1. In Fortnite, navigate to the Shop tab.
  2. Scroll down to the Stranger Things section and select your preferred skin.
  3. Lastly, press and hold the Purchase button to complete the transaction.

If you’re planning to collect multiple characters, The Party Bundle includes Dustin, Lucas, Mike, and Will, along with their themed cosmetics, for 3,400 V-Bucks, saving you 3,400 V-Bucks (50%) compared to buying everything separately.

The Stranger Things Bundle is another option, featuring the Eleven outfit and several themed cosmetics for 2,500 V-Bucks, giving you a savings of 600 V-Bucks.

All Stranger Things cosmetics in Fortnite

1. Dustin’s Slammer

Price: 500 V-Bucks
Also available with: The Dustin Henderson skin priced at 1,500 V-Bucks

2. Dustin’s Backpack

Price: 300 V-Bucks
Also available with: The Dustin Henderson skin priced at 1,500 V-Bucks

3. Wrist Rocket pickaxe

Price: Part of the Wrist Rocket pack priced at 800 V-Bucks
Also available with: The Lucas Sinclair skin priced at 1,500 V-Bucks

4. Lucas’ Backpack back bling

Price: Part of the Wrist Rocket pack priced at 800 V-Bucks
Also available with: The Lucas Sinclair skin priced at 1,500 V-Bucks

5. Upside-down Alphabet emote

Price: 300 V-Bucks

6. Will’s Light Staff pickaxe

Price: 500 V-Bucks
Also available with: The Will Byers skin priced at 1,500 V-Bucks

7. Will’s Backpack back bling

Price: 300 V-Bucks
Also available with: The Will Byers skin priced at 1,500 V-Bucks

8. Mike’s Investigation Kit pickaxe

Price: Part of the Mike’s Investigation Kit pack priced at 800 V-Bucks
Also available with: The Mike Wheeler skin priced at 1,500 V-Bucks

9. Mike’s Backpack back bling

Price: Part of the Mike’s Investigation Kit pack priced at 800 V-Bucks
Also available with: The Mike Wheeler skin priced at 1,500 V-Bucks

10. Lil’ Demogorgon Attack emote

Price: 500 V-Bucks

11. Creel’s Clock back bling

Price: 300 V-Bucks
Also available in: The Vecna Bundle priced at 2,000 V-Bucks

12. Vecnaxe pickaxe

Price: 800 V-Bucks
Also available in: The Vecna Bundle priced at 2,000 V-Bucks

13. Vecna’s Power Draw emote

Price: 300 V-Bucks
Also available in: The Vecna Bundle priced at 2,000 V-Bucks

14. Telekinetic Power Breakfast emote

Price: 200 V-Bucks
Also available in: The Strange Things Bundle priced at 2,500 V-Bucks

15. Steve’s Bat pickaxe

Price: 500 V-Bucks
Also available in: The Strange Things Bundle priced at 2,500 V-Bucks

16. Eddie’s Spear pickaxe

Price: 500 V-Bucks
Also available in: The Strange Things Bundle priced at 2,500 V-Bucks

17. Hopper’s Cabin Diorama back bling

Price: 400 V-Bucks
Also available in: The Strange Things Bundle priced at 2,500 V-Bucks

18. Waffle Extravaganza back bling

Exclusively available in: The Strange Things Bundle priced at 2,500 V-Bucks

19. Tendrils wrap

Price: 500 V-Bucks

Wrapping up

For a decade, Stranger Things has captivated audiences around the world, with its impeccable depiction of the supernatural. For a similar time frame, Fortnite has also amassed a large player-base and grown into one of the most popular games on the planet. Therefore, the coming together of these two iconic franchises is nothing short of a memorable collab.

Over the past several years, Fortnite has consistently partnered with IPs, big and small, to bring a plethora of diverse content into the game. The latest Stranger Things promotion is a part of the same virtually endless run.

With major pop culture events, such as the release of Spider-Man: Brand New Day and Avengers: Doomsday, still to come in 2026, fans can expect Epic Games to flood the online multiplayer game with even more collabs in the coming months. Safe to say, there seem to be plenty of exciting things coming for Fortnite fans sooner rather than later.

FAQs

How to get the Demogorgon skin in Fortnite?

The Demogorgon skin is available as part of the Stranger Things promotion in Fortnite’s Item Shop. You can grab it by exchanging 1,200 V-Bucks.

Can I purchase all Stranger Things skins in a single bundle?

No. While Dustin, Lucas, Will, and Mike are available in a single bundle, other characters such as Eleven and Vecna are available in their own separate bundles. As an exception, the Demogorgon skin and the Chief Hopper skin are only available as individual purchases.

Are there Fortnite collaboration skins similar to the Stranger Things one?

Yes. Besides Stranger Things, Fortnite also collaborated with another Netflix show, Wednesday, in the past, which resulted in the titular character landing as a skin in the Item Shop. Moreover, similar to Vecna, there are several other skins in the game based on intimidating fictional characters, such as Michael Myers and Xenomorph.

mainEntity.name: How to get the Demogorgon skin in Fortnite?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Demogorgon skin is available as part of the Stranger Things promotion in Fortnite's Item Shop. You can grab it by exchanging 1,200 V-Bucks.

mainEntity.name: Can I purchase all Stranger Things skins in a single bundle?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. While Dustin, Lucas, Will, and Mike are available in a single bundle, other characters such as Eleven and Vecna are available in their own separate bundles. As an exception, the Demogorgon skin and the Chief Hopper skin are only available as individual purchases.

mainEntity.name: Are there Fortnite collaboration skins similar to the Stranger Things one?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Besides Stranger Things, Fortnite also collaborated with another Netflix show, Wednesday, in the past, which resulted in the titular character landing as a skin in the Item Shop. Moreover, similar to Vecna, there are several other skins in the game based on intimidating fictional characters, such as Michael Myers and Xenomorph.

title.rendered: Blade Ball codes (July 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Blade Ball codes on July 27, 2026

Blade Ball gets unforgiving once the homing ball starts picking up speed. A single mistimed parry can knock you out in seconds, making every match more intense as the pace increases. While skill and quick reflexes are what ultimately keep you alive, unlocking extra rewards can make your overall progression much smoother.

That’s where Blade Ball codes come in handy. They let you claim free spins, event currency, exclusive cosmetics, and other rewards without spending hours grinding the same matches. These freebies won’t improve your timing or guarantee a win, but they do help you expand your inventory, unlock new items faster, and enjoy everything the game has to offer with less effort.

All working Blade Ball codes

These are the Blade Ball codes worth trying now. Copy them exactly as shown, since one wrong character or an extra space will make a valid code fail.

  • RAMADAN: 1 free spin
  • SPOOKYSEASON: 1 free spin
  • 4BVISITS: Bubble Wand sword
  • SHARKATTACK: 1 free spin
  • SUMMERWHEEL: 1 free spin
  • SUMMERSTARTSHERE: 1 free spin
  • ENERGYSWORDS: 1 free spin
  • GIVEMELUCK: 4x Luck in AFK World for 10 minutes
  • DUNGEONSRELEASE: 50 Dungeon Runes
  • FROGS: 1 free spin
  • GOODVSEVIL: 1 free spin
  • BATTLEROYALE: 1 Storm Ticket
  • RNGEMOTES: 1 free spin
  • FREESPINS: 1 free spin
  • 2BTHANKS: 1 free spin

Redeem the event rewards first. Older codes can disappear when Blade Ball rotates to a new season or limited-time mode.

Expired Blade Ball codes

The following Blade Ball codes are no longer worth trying:

SERPENT, 5BVISITS, DRAGONS, XMAS, DELAYBALL, BPTEAMS, REBIRTHLTM, ROBLOXCLASSIC, GOODVSEVILMODE, MERRYXMAS, EASTERHYPE, ZEROGRAVITY, GALAXYSEASON, FALLINGLTM, TOURNAMENTSW, LAVAFLOOR, LUNARNEWYEAR, LIVEEVENTS, 1.5BTHANKS, UPDATE.DAY, UPD250COINS, SERPENT_HYPE, VISITS_TY

How to redeem Blade Ball codes

The code box is inside the Extra menu. If that menu is missing on a new account, finish one match first and check again.

  1. Open Blade Ball on Roblox.
  2. Select Extra on the top bar.
  3. Choose Codes from the menu.
  4. Paste a working code into the text box.
  5. Press the checkmark to claim the reward.

Why your Blade Ball code is not working

Most failed redemptions come down to the code, your account, or an older server.

  • The code expired after an event or update.
  • You mistyped a letter, number, or punctuation mark.
  • An extra space was pasted before or after the code.
  • You already redeemed it on this Roblox account.
  • Your server is running an older version of the game.
  • You have not completed the first match needed to unlock the Extra menu.

Copy-paste the code first. If it still fails, leave the game and join a fresh server once before treating it as expired.

Where to find more Blade Ball codes

New rewards usually arrive around major updates, visit milestones, seasonal events, or server problems. Watch the Blade Ball Roblox page, join the Wiggity community, and check the Blade Ball Discord or X account when a patch lands.

You can also bookmark this page if you want the usable list without digging through announcement channels and old event posts.

For more competitive Roblox freebies, try the latest Dueling Grounds codes and Roblox RIVALS codes, or browse our complete list of all Roblox game codes.
